items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: And I was playing piano. Piano, drums, Dutch Flick, Roland Flick.

ctx.x: Yeah, we did, but we didn't get the rest of the band, so it kept going.

And, uh, Sidney Spies and, uh, only a five-piece band. And I was playing piano. Piano, drums, Dutch Flick, Roland Flick. Flick. You know that name familiar? His son was the head of the Ford Motor Company, something, you know, down here in New Orleans. But Flick, Dutch was, he fixed, he fixed Eddie Miller's Ford before Eddie Miller went to New York. So he could, it would get him there. Uh, he, Roland was, he, he went into the sort of antique business. And, uh, oddly enough, I bought a piece of property over there…
